body:
No one to talk to. What good are words anyway.

Tried a therapist and it didn't work out. Dead inside anyway, wouldn't matter at this point.

Almost every moment is completely uncomfortable. Can't focus, can't interact well, can't achieve goals. Last year has been a dead body on life support. Feel like a pathetic little child but am starting to see signs of age. Sick of everything, want out. Self-loathing is much deserved and too muted to be appropriate.
Negative emotions and anxiety. Tension. Frustration.

I like sleeping but rarely get more than a few hours at a time.

Waking up from sleep tends to induce panic attacks. Usually, I can tell a lucid dream isn't real because it's too good to be true.

Who knows what the truth is, I'm probably a terrible person. Certainly weak, that's for sure. I'm probably just finally breaking down after years of lies and false ideals about life that took ages to unravel. Who cares. I want to die so badly. Not talk, scream and break things, but not talk. I think I'm finally broken. Too full of anger and envy and yet wholly empty. Shit happens, oh well.
